name: Pazarus Pazaryeri Entegrasyonu for WooCommerce
author: pazarus

sections.description:
Pazarus Pazaryeri Entegrasyonu connects your WooCommerce store to Turkey’s leading online marketplaces. Generate product feeds, map categories, manage inventory, and import orders—all from WordPress.

Key Features:

  • Product Feed Export – Generate marketplace-ready XML/CSV feeds automatically
  • Category Mapping – Map WooCommerce categories to marketplace categories
  • Barcode Management – Bulk edit and manage product barcodes
  • Order Import – Import marketplace orders into WooCommerce
  • Commission Calculator – Calculate potential earnings on each marketplace

Supported Marketplaces:

Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Amazon, Pazarama, Ciceksepeti, PttAVM, Farmazon, Modanisa, Beymen, Idefix, Teknosa, and more.

Need Full Automation?

This plugin provides feed generation and manual sync. For real-time inventory/price synchronization, automated order pulling, and advanced features, upgrade to Pazarus SaaS.

WooCommerce® is a trademark of Automattic Inc.

External Services

This plugin connects to Pazarus.io (operated by Pazarus) to authenticate users and sync WooCommerce data with Turkish marketplaces (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Amazon, etc.).

Service: Pazarus.io — A SaaS platform for marketplace integration.

What data is sent and when:

  • During plugin connection: WordPress site URL is sent to obtain an API key.
  • During webhook registration: WordPress REST API URL is sent.
  • During feed/sync operations: Product data (name, SKU, price, stock, barcode, images) is sent when the user explicitly triggers an export or sync.

Data is sent only when triggered by the user. No background tracking.

Privacy Policy: https://pazarus.io/privacy
Terms of Service: https://pazarus.io/terms

By using this plugin, you agree to the Pazarus.io Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

License: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html

Support

For questions and support, visit Pazarus Help.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress admin
  3. Go to the Pazarus menu in the sidebar
  4. Click “Connect to Pazarus” and authorize your account
  5. Configure marketplace feed settings
sections.faq:
What is a product feed?

A feed is an automated export of your WooCommerce products in marketplace format (XML/CSV). Upload it to the marketplace to list your products.

Do I need a Pazarus account?

Yes, but it’s free. The plugin integrates with your Pazarus account for secure connectivity and data management.

Does this plugin sync inventory in real-time?

No, this plugin generates feeds and manual imports. For real-time synchronization, upgrade to Pazarus SaaS.

Which marketplaces are supported?

Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Amazon, Pazarama, Ciceksepeti, PttAVM, Farmazon, Modanisa, Beymen, Idefix, and Teknosa.
